definition: An organized transferable system of stable behaviours for bounding AI-delegated cognition and preserving continuity across projects through human purpose and authority, bounded delegation, selected durable material trace with authoritative result/current state, and explicit continuation, with assurance scaled separately to risk.
exclusions: Raw transcript-only archives without selected decisions, authority, authoritative result, and continuation.
Provenance systems that omit purpose, acceptance or stop responsibility, result selection, or continuation.
Governance and risk registers without selected work, result, decision, and continuation continuity.
Ordinary project frameworks that do not require the full F1-F4 composition for AI-delegated work.
primary_category_claim: This is a methodology for traceable AI-delegated work.
ambiguities: The packet does not specify a minimum representation format or vocabulary beyond durable satisfaction of the four functions.
The threshold for what counts as a material source, decision, or alternative is risk-sensitive and not operationally quantified in the packet.
An explicit closed or no-next-action status appears to satisfy continuation, but the packet does not define all acceptable terminal-state formulations.
